notes.title: Mixing ideas from Chess and base-building strategy games, protect your King in Emplacement
notes.content:
Emplacement is a King versus King turn-based strategy game, all about placing down tiles in a way that's a bit like Chess mixed with ideas from other more traditional turn-based strategy games.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/12/mixing-ideas-from-chess-and-base-building-strategy-games-protect-your-king-in-emplacement

notes.title: Emplacement - Out now!!
notes.content:
Hi Gamers!

[h2]What is Emplacement?[/h2]
Emplacement introduces a unique blend of strategic gameplay, requiring your keen eye for construction and battle tactics. As a player, your task is multifaceted: lay down tiles to forge farms and barracks, harness their productivity to amass resources and units, and intertwine these tiles to craft diverse layouts. Every twist and turn in your arrangement shapes your strategies for victory.

[h2]The Challenge Awaits![/h2]
Your ultimate quest? Topple your adversaries by targeting their king! Embrace the challenge as you maneuver your way through intricately designed landscapes, adjusting and evolving your gameplay with each move. Connect, rotate, and innovate to outsmart opponents and claim triumph.

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Play through single player, learn new strategies, and beat the game your way! 
[*] Survival, see how long your strategy can hold up against an endless horde! 
[*] PvP! Make yourself known in emplacement by becoming the best and being the top of the leaderboard! 
[*] Choose from 5 army types for single player & survival! Currently not available in PvP but I will slowly be rolled out as we meet balancing requirements. 
[/list]
Follow future updates [url=https://www.threads.net/@glaikunn]@Glaikunt_[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.gg/qxrawPQfEV]discord[/url] to chat with other fans. You can also watch the [url=https://youtu.be/XoE9SYVxpSU?si=gGy1AVXmvpNgX2of]trailer[/url] to see the game in action.

Thank you for your support and interest in Emplacement. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.
Glaikunt

notes.title: Emplacement Offcial Release - 14 Dec 2023
notes.content:
Hi!

Emplacement is a unique game that combines the elements of turn-based strategy and builder games. In Emplacement, you must place tiles to construct farms and barracks, and use them to produce resources and units. You can connect tiles and rotate them around to create different layouts and strategies. Your goal is to kill the other player’s king, similar to in chess, but with more freedom and creativity. 

Emplacement features three game modes: PvP, Single Player, and Survival. In PvP, you can challenge other players online and test your skills and tactics. In Single Player, you can play against AI opponents with different difficulty levels and personalities. In Survival, you can face endless waves of enemies and see how long you can last.

Emplacement is a solo game dev project that has been in development for just about 2 years. It is a passion project that aims to offer a fresh and fun experience for strategy and builder fans. Emplacement will be released on Steam on [i][b]14 Dec 2023[/b][/i]. You can wishlist it now and get notified when it launches.

If you are interested in Emplacement, you can follow the game on [url=https://www.threads.net/@glaikunt_]@Glaikunt_[/url] and join the [url=discord.gg/aQdVDsC8kc]discord[/url] to get the latest updates and chat with other fans. You can also watch the [url=https://youtu.be/XoE9SYVxpSU?si=gGy1AVXmvpNgX2of]trailer[/url] to see the game in action.

Thank you for your support and interest in Emplacement. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.
Glaikunt
